question: Under what temporal condition are old age and death said to be destroyed?
premises: A duration of one year is given.
The condition is that it has been practiced when or for that time.
Old age and death are the subjects said to be destroyed.
inference: When this has been practiced for one year, old age and death are destroyed.
uncertainties: The referent of the practice is presupposed from the preceding verses.
plain_english: When practiced for one year, old age and death are destroyed.
